## Company Overview
Kitchen and Bathroom Remodeling Pros is a licensed, bonded, and insured remodeling contractor based in Seattle, WA. We serve 50+ cities across King County, Pierce County, and Snohomish County. Our team specializes in residential kitchen and bathroom remodeling, with 500+ completed projects and a 4.98-star customer rating.
